commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' That was close by Rodrygo (Real Madrid)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
90+2' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.

90+2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' A cross by Jose Morales (Levante) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
82' Substitution. David Alaba (Real Madrid) has come on for Alvaro Carreras.
82' Here is a change. Dani Ceballos is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Kylian Mbappe as he is replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
81' The attendance for today's match is 23361.

81' That was close by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
80' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Mathew Ryan is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

79' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has a big opportunity! He finds some space for a shot inside the penalty box after collecting a lofted pass and sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
76' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

76' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.
74' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iker Losada (Levante) replacing Etta Eyong.
74' Ivan Romero goes off the pitch and Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) comes on.
74' Substitution. Carlos Alvarez is replaced by Jose Morales (Levante).

73' Etta Eyong (Levante) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) for Federico Valverde.
71' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) replaces Franco Mastantuono.

45+1' A shot from the edge of the box by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
41' Great save! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Mathew Ryan.

24' That didn't go as planned! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Mathew Ryan, who easily kept it out.

23' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) takes a short corner kick.

22' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
22' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the crossbar and wastes a promising chance.

21' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Mathew Ryan was alert and the score remained the same.
19' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.

13' Etta Eyong (Levante) prepares to take a corner kick.
